name: Qwen3.8 2B Distill
description: A reasoning model distilled from Qwen3.8 2.4T into the Qwen3.5 2B architecture. Thinks before answering; needs a llama.cpp build with Gated DeltaNet support.

name: Qwen3 0.6B
description: The smallest Qwen3. Switches between a thinking mode for hard problems and a direct mode for everyday chat, and is multilingual throughout.

name: Qwen3.5 2B
description: Vision and language in one model, trained together from the start rather than bolted on. Covers 201 languages; needs a recent llama.cpp build.

name: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct
description: A dependable text-only all-rounder from the Qwen2.5 generation, good at following instructions and producing structured output such as JSON.

name: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct
description: The lightest Qwen2.5 instruct model. Text only, and small enough to stay responsive on modest hardware.

name: Qwen3.5 0.8B
description: The compact Qwen3.5. Reads images as well as text at a size that suits a phone; needs a recent llama.cpp build.

name: Qwen3 VL 2B Instruct
description: Qwen3's dedicated vision model. Strong on reading text in images, documents and charts, and answers directly without a reasoning pass.

name: Qwen3.5 0.8B MTP
description: Qwen3.5 0.8B shipped with multi-token prediction heads, which roughly halve generation time where the runtime supports them.

name: Qwen3 VL 2B Thinking
description: The reasoning counterpart to Qwen3 VL 2B. Works through a problem before replying, which helps on multi-step visual and maths questions.

name: LFM2.5 230M
description: A hybrid architecture from Liquid AI built for edge devices. Tiny and quick, with a quantisation-aware build that holds up well at 4-bit.

name: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct
description: The instruction-tuned LFM2.5, extended with further pre-training and reinforcement learning. Multilingual and still sized for a phone.

name: LFM2.5 VL 450M
description: Liquid AI's smallest vision model. Describes and answers questions about images at a size few vision models reach.

name: LFM2.5 VL 1.6B
description: The larger LFM2.5 vision model, trading some speed for noticeably better image understanding. Multilingual.

name: MiniCPM V 4.6
description: A SigLIP2 vision encoder on a Qwen3.5 0.8B base. Handles single images, several at once, and video, and compresses visual tokens to stay fast.

name: MiniCPM5 2B
description: A dense 2B built for on-device use, at its best on code, maths, long documents and agent-style tool use. Text only despite the MiniCPM name.

name: SmolVLM2 256M Video Instruct
description: About the smallest model that can look at an image or a video and describe it. A size test more than a quality one.

name: Gemma 3 1B IT
description: Google's instruction-tuned Gemma 3 at 1B, with a 32K context. Text only — vision starts at the 4B size in this family.

name: Gemma 3 270M IT
description: The smallest Gemma 3, instruction-tuned. Meant as a base to fine-tune for one narrow job rather than as a general assistant.

name: FunctionGemma 270M IT
description: A Gemma 3 270M trained purely to call functions. Google intend it to be fine-tuned for a specific tool set; it is not meant for conversation.

name: Granite 4.0 350M
description: IBM's Granite 4.0 Nano, instruction-tuned for on-device work. Follows instructions closely and calls tools with an OpenAI-style schema.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct 128K
description: Qwen2.5 trained on code, in its smallest size, with the context stretched to 128K so a whole file fits in one go.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 1.5B Instruct 128K
description: The 1.5B Qwen2.5 Coder with a 128K context. Markedly better at generating and explaining code than the 0.5B, for roughly three times the size.

name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
description: Meta's 1B, tuned for multilingual dialogue, summarising and retrieval. Text only — the vision Llama 3.2 models start at 11B.

name: Hy-MT2 1.8B
description: Tencent's translation specialist, covering 33 languages and taking instructions about how to translate. Not a general-purpose chat model.
